name: zoom-notetaker
title: Zoom notetaker
summary: Joins a Zoom meeting in a headless browser, records it, and writes up the notes.
blurb: Paste a Zoom link and get minutes back — with no meeting-bot service in the loop. One tool drives a local headless Chromium into the call through Zoom's web client, records the meeting's audio in the page, and transcribes it with whisper.cpp on your machine — the audio never leaves it. whisper-cli, ffmpeg and the models are prerequisites the CLI checks before the run and offers to install when missing. Env vars swap the transcriber out: STT_URL points at any OpenAI-compatible transcription endpoint (the OpenAI API, a local faster-whisper server), STT_COMMAND at a command of your own, and a captions mode reads Zoom's own live captions instead, needing no STT at all. The same fixed-heading prompt as meeting-notes turns the transcript into a summary, decisions, action items and open questions — and the flow branches to a plain-spoken failure end when the browser could not get in, nothing made a sound, or the transcriber failed, rather than summarizing a meeting it never heard.
